src/grammar/values.ts.summary: Provides parser implementations that extract and convert raw input into typed primitive values like text, numbers, and identifiers.

src/grammar/list.ts.summary: Enables parsing of comma-separated element sequences in both inline and multi-line formats.

src/grammar/tagClause.ts.summary: Parses individual DSL tag clauses, converting raw text into keywords, stat bonuses with optional ranges or percentages, or duration values.

src/content/tuningVariables.ts.summary: This module defines the constant names for numeric balance tuning values and validates that they satisfy required constraints during initialization.

src/content/variable.ts.summary: It specifies how to parse and structure named numeric state variables from DSL content sections.

src/content/resource.ts.summary: Parses DSL declarations of pooled numeric values with regeneration rates and conditional actions that fire when pools empty or fill completely.

src/content/stat.ts.summary: Provides the schema for parsing character statistics from DSL, with support for base values that can be fixed numbers or ranges sampled at runtime.

src/runtime/save.ts.summary: Persists game state as a sparse differential against the initialized baseline, capturing only changes to minimize serialized size and rejecting saves from incompatible versions.

src/runtime/state.ts.summary: Defines the mutable game state structure and provides operations to advance simulated time and manage active actions.

src/runtime/tuning.ts.summary: Retrieves game balance parameters from the content registry at runtime, with hardcoded defaults for missing values.

src/runtime/stats.ts.summary: Computes combat-relevant metrics by combining base statistics with active buffs and action effects.
